text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Cabinet discusses the 1997 draft budget and lists of detainees to be pardoned under a royal decree.
- Electricity company workers continue their strike for fourth day and the General Workers Union calls for ending the stoppage.

- Crown Prince says in an interview with Israel's channel 2 television that the "alternative to peace is the domination of power and conflict, we reject any change to the status quo in the occupied lands".
- Prime Minister Abdul Karim al-Kabariti says ties with the Arab Gulf states have improved.
- Kabariti leaves to Spain on Sunday.
- Stock market bouyed by optimism over expected approval of new economic legislation in the new parliamentary session.
- Amman governor orders preventing gathering of people around the striking electricity company workers.
- Regent: "Israel should come to terms with coexistence with the Palestinians based on respect."
